title: Moon Libration
text: Implement Moon librations, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Ephemeris model} sets Ephemeris model; {Epoch}, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior and {Calculate rates} sets the calculate rate of Moon libration. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: T JD
ports.summary: Julian date scalar | positive | between minimum and maximum Julian dates

ports.name: ω (rad/day)
ports.summary: Moon libration Euler angular rate vector

params.name: Epoch
params.values: Epoch Julian date (default) | T0 and elapsed Julian time

params.name: Ephemeris model
params.values: Ephemeris model DE405 (default) | DE421 | DE423 | DE430 | DE432t

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error

params.name: Calculate rates
params.values: Calculate rate of Moon libration on (default) | off
